approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.
approval.scope: One immutable two-process GPU C09 inference/evaluation. Process 1 has no Teacher argument; process 2 evaluates frozen outputs. No threshold/model update, C10, M-TARE, graph or planner access.

estimated_cost.compute: GPU inference only: 98034 spatial-encoder frames plus 73386 causal-episode observations

evidence.complete_visual_review: C07-C08 selection versus C09 precision/recall in PNG/PDF/SVG with machine source.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source/environment/process-separation/population/resource drift or pre-registered C09 gate failure seals FAIL. No retry, threshold change, frame masking, graph tuning, C10 read or planner compensation.
evidence.machine_metrics: Per-event decision trigger precision/recall/F1, identity coverage and exact input/inference counts.

failure_policy: Any source/environment/process-separation/population/resource drift or pre-registered C09 gate failure seals FAIL. No retry, threshold change, frame masking, graph tuning, C10 read or planner compensation.

methods.baseline: The frozen five-frame GSE event output that produced unsafe raw graph candidates is the direct failure baseline; C07-C08 decision-trigger performance is the generalization reference.
methods.fallback: If any pre-registered C09 decision-node gate fails, stop this 12-frame route and implement a separately selected five-frame decision gate on C07-C08; do not tune graph parameters or threshold on C09.
methods.main: For each seed, encode all C09 LiDAR scans with its frozen spatial encoder, aggregate a 12-frame past-only history with its frozen causal GRU, average three event distributions, collapse contiguous responses at threshold 0.986, and retain only junction/terminal triggers.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.aggregate: Nonvacuous decision triggers, class-correct precision>=0.98, false trigger fraction<=0.01 and episode recall>=0.60.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.forbidden: Threshold/checkpoint selection, optimizer/model update, C10, strict test, M-TARE, graph and planner operations all zero.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.junction: Precision>=0.98, episode recall>=0.50 and decision-identity coverage>=0.80.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.population: Exactly 10 worlds, 32678 unique frames, 24462 observations, 2054 traversals, 237678 valid past-reference cells, 426 junction episodes/71 identities and 114 terminal episodes/59 identities.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.separation: Inference Teacher/event/episode/identity reads and future-reference cells are exactly zero; evaluation begins only after frozen output materialization.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.terminal: Precision>=0.98, episode recall>=0.75 and decision-identity coverage>=0.80.

purpose: Qualify the already frozen 12-frame past-only junction/terminal trigger as the Factorized GSE-Graph decision-node generator on every C09 world.
retention: Retain three seed outputs, ensemble outputs, trigger rows, past-reference proof, metrics, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and exact SHA-256 seal.

sampling.independent_units: Ten unseen procedural C09 topology worlds; structural episode and decision identity are reporting units.
sampling.rule: All 24462 observations from all directed C09 traversals; each model input uses the current scan plus up to eleven strictly past scans from the same traversal.
sampling.temporal_context: Exactly 12 left-padded causal scan slots, minimum 5 and maximum 12 valid scans; 237678 valid reference cells and zero future cells.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use with sealed provenance.
raw_sources: Ten sealed C09 validation Zarr shards with 32678 unique LiDAR frames and a Teacher-free sequence/frame manifest.
Three frozen GSE spatial encoders and their aligned C09 baseline event logits.
Three frozen 12-frame causal episode checkpoints and the C07-C08-selected threshold 0.986.
C09 Teacher rows opened only by the second evaluation process.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C09 was previously used for frozen perception and association validation, but never for causal-episode checkpoint or threshold selection. The decision-node-only reuse of an aggregate failed run is disclosed: junction/terminal selection precision/recall passed, while turn/transition caused the aggregate failure. C09 does not choose this restriction or any value.
split.leakage_audit: The runner enforces process separation. Inference receives dataset, base models and causal episode models only; it has no Teacher path. Teacher event/episode/identity are first opened after ensemble outputs and triggers exist.
split.model_fit: C01-C06 only in the sealed upstream runs; no fit occurs here.
split.selection: C07-C08 only selected checkpoints and structural threshold 0.986 upstream.
split.strict_test: C10 and all M-TARE/closed-loop worlds remain unread.
split.validation: Exactly all ten C09 worlds and all 24462 observations; no world, event, identity or frame selection.

teacher.association: A trigger is correct only if its row belongs to a previously unmatched decision episode and its predicted event class is correct.
teacher.event: Contiguous junction and terminal Teacher rows form 426 and 114 decision episodes.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Only frozen junction/terminal triggers may request a structural node. Turn and geometry-transition outputs remain edge attributes and cannot create nodes.
teacher.source: Sealed TNG/spline/mesh C09 Teacher opened only for post-inference evaluation.
teacher.valid_mask: All C09 rows are retained. Only junction/terminal episodes enter decision-node recall; any predicted junction/terminal on corridor, turn or transition is a false trigger.
